scope: derived compact evidence; evaluator fields never sent to model; raw images and full inputs remain local

initial_plan.goal_evidence: Red sphere detected at axial depth 4.13m, surface range 4.26m. Appears small and distant, likely on a sloped or elevated surface ahead.
initial_plan.tentative_route: Move forward along the central path, maintaining forward-facing orientation. Adjust heading slightly upward to align with the red sphere's apparent elevation. Avoid sharp turns until closer to the target.
initial_plan.occlusion_hypothesis: No immediate occluding surfaces visible in the current frame. However, the terrain slope may obscure the sphere from view if the robot ascends too steeply or turns away from the direct line of sight.
initial_plan.uncertainty: High uncertainty in exact target location and terrain geometry beyond the visible range. Depth measurements are noisy; surface range suggests potential occlusion or surface curvature. No ground truth map or coordinates available.
initial_plan.revision_trigger: If the red sphere disappears from view during motion, or if depth measurements become inconsistent with visual tracking, or if the robot encounters a surface that blocks the line of sight.

result.arrival_endpoint: automatic 3 consecutive evaluator samples; separate from VLM STOP
